positions.name: UnitOfExpandAndPageForm
positions.frame: what is the unit of expand in the frame index, and what must a page carry so the reader keeps the context around a position?
positions.why: These statements all ask what an expand returns and what a page shows. Tiering and actor hubs, call and narrative as the unit, a document page shown whole with its edges, the 15K page limit, and the question of whether a transaction's siblings arrive together all read this way. The tension is between context-preserving whole units and the cost of too much data, which the re-scored page weights make concrete.

positions.name: FrameAloneVersusFrameWithStatements
positions.frame: can a frame alone be used to locate relevance, or does meaning need the frame read together with its statements?
positions.why: The group holds the design stance that statements are support for a direction and that a frame is a lens, not the carrier of meaning. It sets that stance beside the open 'maybe' answer and the measured frames-only recoveries. Both sides stay in tension: frames-only is admitted to lose something, yet frames-only recall is tested as a locator.

positions.name: RecallReferenceAndJudgedOracle
positions.frame: what is the right reference for scoring recall, and how is exhaustiveness and precision confirmed rather than assumed?
positions.why: Scoring against production's placements is rejected as a target. A judged set is built from exhaustive recall, big-model arms, small-model overlays, her review, and a complement pass. The measured gaps, including 82 to 88 percent and production recovering 5 of 17, 1 of 34 and 2 of 16, are weighed against the question of what full recall is.

positions.name: BuildVersusTakeEngineForRead
positions.frame: which parts of the read path are ours to build (steering) and which should come from mature engine primitives (recall and precision)?
positions.why: The group separates novel steering from recall and precision. It concedes the hand-rolled read layer as the weak link, argues for shoulders-of-giants over cowboyism, and records the ruled consequences and the extend-first rule. Steering is kept as ours while recall goes to textbook engines, retiring the hand-rolled parts only if the engines tie or win on the oracle.

positions.name: WhatAnOutputCapIsFor
positions.frame: what is an output cap for, and when should a builder set one rather than ask for brevity in the prompt?
positions.why: The circuit-breaker view says a cap guards runaway behaviour and is not a length control. The rule is written into the llm-calls rules file, and the model that ran away uncapped sits beside it as evidence.

positions.name: WhenADesignMayBeExported
positions.frame: when may a design leave the session that is building it and be passed to other sessions as a build input?
positions.why: Nothing is exported until the design is tested. The earlier ruling had already been passed on as rulings, which prompts the call to slow down: design fully, then test, then implement. The prompt rewrite is parked on the same ordering, so the group is about sequencing.
